To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the immobilization of YLIP2 on an epoxy support structure with or/and BA and gelatin surface modifications is an effective method to enhance the activity of immobilized YLIP2.
the immobilized YLIP2 on a gelatin/BA modified support structure has a higher activity than that on the native support structure.
the activity of YLIP2 immobilized on a support structure depends on the support properties and that a moderate support surface environment is important for elevated enzyme activity.
In summary, our research is concerned with
an improved and effective immobilization method for YLIP2 on an epoxy support structure with or/and amine and/or protein modifications.
a novel method for immobilizing Ylipase2 on epoxy polymeric supports with different modification methods.
the immobilization of YLIP2 onto a novel amine and protein functionalized support and the influence of support modification on the lipase activity.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a moderate support surface with a suitable micro-environment is important for achieving high enzyme activity.
the synergistic effects of amide and amine groups in the support surface structure can improve the activity of YLIP2 immobilized on the support structure.
the synergistic effect of amine and/or protein modification on the support surface structure is crucial for enhancing the immobilized lipases activity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the immobilized lipases with the highest activity were obtained on the support structure with moderate BA and gelatin modifications.
the support surface microenvironment can be regulated by amine and protein modifications and that this regulation is crucial for the activity of immobilized lipase.
a support with moderate hydrophilicity and a moderate surface micro-environment is crucial for the immobilization of lipase.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synergistic effects of BA and gelation modification on a support surface structure could be a promising method for improving the activity of an enzyme.
a moderate surface micro-environment is crucial to support the activity of immobilized lipase.
the immobilized lipases on the modified supports can be used in the synthesis of esters with high yields and high selectivities.
